Name: Elpaal, Son of Hushim
Summary: Son of Shaharaim by Hushim, father of Eber, Misham, Shamed, Beriah, and Shema.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:11: Son of Shaharaim by Hushim, father of Eber, Misham, Shamed, Beriah, and Shema.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Elpaal stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
